title: Salesloft Pricing in 2026: No Public Price, What Advanced and Elite Include
summary: Salesloft publishes no prices: its pricing address leads to Talk to Sales. See the Advanced and Elite packages, the Dialer add-on, $1 LocalDial fees and terms.
body_markdown:
Salesloft does not publish prices. On November 18, 2026 its pricing address redirected to a Talk to Sales page with a booking form and no plans. Salesloft's help center names two packages, Advanced and Elite, and says the Salesloft Dialer is an add-on to either one. The only dollar figures on the pages read are for LocalDial numbers: $1 to provision each number and $1 a month for each number in use.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a dialer that works inside Salesloft. Every Salesloft detail below comes from Salesloft's own website, help center, Master Subscription Agreement and Product-Specific Terms, opened on November 18, 2026. No price here comes from a review site. No Salesloft account was used and nothing was tested. For the calling routes inside Salesloft, see[how to make calls from Salesloft](https://www.trellus.ai/post/how-to-make-calls-from-salesloft) .


## Salesloft pricing at a glance


The address[salesloft.com/pricing](https://www.salesloft.com/pricing) now leads to a page titled Talk to Sales. The package names and contents below come from Salesloft's help center article[Salesloft Packages and Availability](https://help.salesloft.com/s/article/Salesloft-Packages-and-Availability) , and the dialer rows from its[Dialer Pricing Guide](https://help.salesloft.com/s/article/Dialer-Pricing-Guide) . Both were last published on October 6, 2026.


Salesloft packages and dialer add-ons as listed in Salesloft's own help center, read on November 18, 2026. Salesloft publishes no monthly or annual price for any package. Package or add-on Published price Seat minimum Free trial What is included for calling


Advanced Not published, monthly or annual None stated None listed Cadence, Conversations, Deals, Rhythm, coaching and analytics. Conversation intelligence covers call recording, transcription and analytics. The Dialer is not included


Elite Not published, monthly or annual None stated None listed Advanced plus Sandbox, Multi-team and no-code custom object signals. The Dialer is not included


Dialer add-on: Unlimited Talk and Text North America Not published None stated None listed Calls to the US, Canada and other regions on the +1 country code with no per-minute charges, under a fair usage policy


Dialer add-on: Unlimited Talk Europe Not published None stated None listed Calls to 33 listed European countries at a flat rate, under the same policy


LocalDial numbers $1 to provision each number, then $1 per number a month Not applicable Not applicable Calls shown from an area code local to the prospect


Unlimited LocalDial: U.S. Not published None stated None listed LocalDial across US area codes without the monthly number charges


The packages article says every plan includes Rhythm, Conversations, Deals, Cadence, Coaching, Sales Email, the Ask Salesloft Agent, automation, calendaring, CRM sync, analytics and mobile app access. It notes that Deals is only available to customers whose CRM is Salesforce, and that calling from the mobile app needs the Dialer add-on.


## What changes the real cost of Salesloft


The price comes from a quote. These are the parts Salesloft's pages name.


### The package


The article says Advanced is for revenue teams that need to build pipeline, and Elite is for complex organizations. Elite adds three things: Sandbox testing environments, Multi-team management and signals from Salesforce custom objects.


Older package names are still in use. The article says legacy packages were sold from February 2020 through August 2025, and that former license types such as Essentials and Prospect now show as Legacy. Parts of its FAQ still say "Advanced and Premier". Check which package name is on your quote.


### The Dialer add-on


Neither package includes calling. The Dialer Pricing Guide says a team admin must buy Unlimited Calling modules for the team to use the Dialer, through the Customer Success Manager. The[Dialer and Messenger article](https://help.salesloft.com/s/article/Salesloft-Dialer-and-Messenger) adds that texting needs the Dialer add-on and a Talk and Text plan. No module price is published.


### Calls outside an unlimited plan


Salesloft's[Product-Specific Terms](https://www.salesloft.com/legal/product-specific-terms) describe a Variable Dialer. Calls or texts without an unlimited plan, or to a place the plan does not cover, are charged per minute by actual usage and invoiced in arrears for the prior month. The rates depend on where the call starts and ends. They are not on the pages read for this article.


The[Manage Dialer Invoices article](https://help.salesloft.com/s/article/Manage-Dialer-Invoices) says dialer charges arrive on their own monthly invoice, apart from the subscription invoice. Dialer invoices must be paid by credit card. A saved card is charged within 5 days of the invoice.


### The fair usage limit


Both unlimited plans are subject to a fair usage policy. The Product-Specific Terms define excessive use as more than 3,000 minutes per unlimited dialer user in a month, pooled across those users. If a team goes over in two months of any rolling twelve, Salesloft may charge for the excess.


### LocalDial numbers


The Dialer Pricing Guide lists $1 to provision each new LocalDial number, one for each area code called, and $1 a month for each number in use. So a new number costs $2 in its first month. The same $1 monthly price is listed for the United States, Alaska, and Canada and international. The guide says pricing can change without notice.


Unlimited LocalDial: U.S. removes the monthly charges for US area codes, including Alaska and Hawaii. Canadian and international numbers stay on the standard price. The guide also says Salesloft does not charge for call recordings or their storage.


### AI agents and other add-ons


The packages article lists three more add-ons for any package: Forecasting, Account Agent and Coaching Agent. None has a published price. The Product-Specific Terms say Account Agent includes 100 agent runs per user a month for the Research Agent, pooled across users. Above that, Salesloft may charge more, require an upgrade or limit access. The terms call the current Account Agent price promotional and say it can change at renewal.


### Contract terms


The current[Master Subscription Agreement](https://www.salesloft.com/legal/msa-2026-02-10) , in effect since February 10, 2026, covers Salesloft and its affiliate Clari. It says fees are set in the order form, are non-cancelable, are invoiced in advance and are due within 30 days of the invoice. Fees paid are non-refundable except where the agreement says otherwise.


Users added mid-term are charged the same price for that subscription type, prorated. Multi-year subscriptions are committed for the whole term, even when paid in yearly installments. The agreement states no term length, renewal rule or seat minimum, so those sit in the order form. Salesloft's[cancellation article](https://help.salesloft.com/s/article/Account-Cancellation) says to contact your account manager or Customer Success to cancel.


## Who Salesloft fits and who it does not


Salesloft's website groups its products by role: Cadence, Conversation Intelligence, Deals and Rhythm for account teams, and Clari Forecast, Inspect and Analytics for revenue leaders. That fits a team that wants cadences, call recording, deal management and forecasting from one vendor, with Elite for an organization that runs several teams.


Its[dialer page](https://www.salesloft.com/platform/dialer-messenger) describes one-click calling and texting, LocalDial, pre-recorded voicemail drop and a Live Call Studio where managers listen, whisper or join.


Salesloft is a weaker fit for a buyer who needs a public price to build a budget, or who wants to buy a seat online the same day. The pricing address leads to a sales conversation. It is also a weaker fit for a team that expects calling in the base price, because the Dialer is an add-on with its own invoice.


The dialer page does not mention calling several numbers at once. A team that wants that adds another dialer on top.

## Frequently asked questions


### How much does Salesloft cost?


Salesloft does not publish a price. Its pricing address leads to a Talk to Sales page, and its help center gives no price for the Advanced or Elite package or for the Dialer add-on.


### What packages does Salesloft sell?


Salesloft's help center names two: Advanced and Elite. Elite adds Sandbox, Multi-team and no-code custom object signals. Add-ons for either package are the Dialer, Forecasting, Account Agent and Coaching Agent.


### Is the Salesloft Dialer included in the package price?


No. Salesloft's help center says the Dialer is an add-on to any package, and that a team must buy Unlimited Calling modules to use it. The plans are Unlimited Talk and Text North America and Unlimited Talk Europe. Their prices are not published.


### How much do Salesloft LocalDial numbers cost?


The Dialer Pricing Guide lists $1 to provision each new LocalDial number and $1 a month for each number in use, so $2 in the first month. The Unlimited LocalDial: U.S. plan removes the monthly charges for US area codes. Its price is not published.


### Is calling unlimited on Salesloft?


Within limits. The unlimited plans carry no per-minute charges inside their regions. Salesloft's terms define excessive use as more than 3,000 minutes per unlimited dialer user a month, pooled, and allow charges if a team exceeds that in two months of a rolling twelve.


### Does Salesloft have a free trial?


The Salesloft pages read for this guide list no free trial or free plan. Its Master Subscription Agreement says trial programs are optional and offered at Salesloft's discretion.
